Inside the network

Every cell below is a CSS custom property, recomputed by the browser each time a pixel changes.

Your drawing is cropped, squared and resampled to 8×8, then passed through two ReLU layers. The winning digit is picked with clamp() masks and printed with a CSS counter. Trained on MNIST and font-rendered digits.
